client_auth_key.description: Client certificate key passed as string

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for connection to wait for a TLS handshake. Zero means no timeout

host.description: The hostname or IP address of the NSX manager.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of HTTP client retries

project.description: Identifier for the project under the organisation

retry_interval.description: Delay interval in milliseconds between retries of a request

retry_on_status_codes.description: HTTP replies status codes to retry on

vpc.description: Identifier for the VPC under the project of an organisation

display_name.description: The display name of the object.

nsx_id.description: The id of the object on NSX.

path.description: The complete policy path of the object.

domain.description: The domain ID of the object. Applicable for groups.

scope.description: The scope in which the object exists or spans out of. It can be any one of vpc, project or infra.
